question: How many independent princely states were integrated in India after independence?
solution:
The correct answer is **__562__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There are **562** independently princely states that were integrated into India after independence.
 
• These states were given the choice of joining either India or Pakistan.
 
• In these states, 549 of the 552 princely states agreed to join India.
 
• Before the Partition of India in 1947, **approx 584** princely states, also known as "native states", exists in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hyderabad** was the largest princely state in India.
 
• **Hyderabad **was also the richest of all princely states.
